data.body: Phase 2 found the flow-watchdog dead-PID/no-result classifier exists in .hive-flow/data/tmux-router/flow-watchdog.cjs but runOnce never calls it. The file is untracked and has no tracked source, so the recovery mechanism is unshipped/unreviewed while 0bb4 acceptance depends on it. Governance ruling: do not commit the live data-dir blob as-is; promote or replace it with reviewed tracked source plus an install/generation path, or explicitly remove it from the product acceptance surface. Also cover related untracked flow-watchdog blindspots P2-SH3 and P2-SL4 while touching this surface.
data.title: P2-SH1 promote flow-watchdog to tracked source and wire liveness classifier
